changes.summary: Fail closed in the EU, UK, and South Korea as required by the exact Tencent Hunyuan Community License Agreement.
Correct the offloaded single-Spark memory envelope to require 112 GB plus the existing 8 GB system reserve, allowing admission on a healthy 128 GB Spark.
Validate the exact 121-frame MP4 stream before atomically publishing output.mp4 and reject malformed signed inputs before model loading.
Replaced the hidden prompt default with a required signed prompt slot and bound the exact MP4 output contract.
Made the adapter consume the controller-authenticated slot manifest before model loading.
Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Replaced the incomplete native snapshot with the complete 720p T2V Diffusers conversion and hash-locked CUDA 13 ARM64 runtime.
Bound 720p T2V to its self-contained non-distilled pipeline, 50 steps, CFG 6, local-only component loading, and MP4 verification.
Corrected the model authority from Apache-2.0 to the territorial Tencent Hunyuan Community License.
Corrected the immutable HunyuanVideo 1.5 snapshot and dependent disk resource sizes from the complete upstream inventory.
Marked the candidate as requiring a model-specific video adapter before container and physical Spark acceptance.
Initial reviewed catalog release of HunyuanVideo 1.5 T2V diffusers single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
